sujātāsūṭhekato:
First of all, taking refuge in the Three Gems or
primarily, established in the Threefold Refuge (Buddha, Dhamma, and Sangha).
sujacca: [ su + jāti +a. Sujātya=sujacca. Samāsanta a-paccaññaḥ. Sujātiya-saṃ. ] (ti) CL=7 A person has a good family lineage.
sujaggita: [ su + jaggita=jagga + ta. Jaggita-krañña့. ] (ti) CL=7 Should be clean and tidy.
sujaggitatara: [ sujaggita + tara ] (ti) CL=7 Should be clean and tidy than before.
sujampati: [ sujā + pati. Sujāya asura-kaññāya pati sujampati. Dhāna, ṭī, 18. ] (pu) CL=7 A Sakka (is the husband of a female asurā deva named Suja).
sujana: [ su + jana. Sundaro jano sujano. Kappadduma. Sujana-saṃ. Sujaṇa-addhamāgadhī. ] (pu) CL=7 A virtuous man.
sujanahadayaparitosajanana: [ sujana + hadaya + paritosa + janana ] (na) CL=7 Causing the pleasure of the minds of the virtuous individuals.
sujanita: [ su + jana + ṇe + ta ]  CL=9 well-executed, well-accomplished.
sujava: [ su + java. Sujavasa-saṃ. ] (ti) CL=7 Moving with good speed.
sujaya: [ su + ji + a. Sujaya-saṃ. Sujcyaya-sya. ] (ti) CL=7 (1) Should be easily conquered. Capable of achieving easily. (2) Clean and pure.
sujighacchita: [ su + jighacchita= ji + ghasa + ta. Rū. 621. Jighacchā + ita. Jighacchā sañjātā yassa jighacchito. Dhāna, ṭī. 756. Nirutti. 547. Su + jighatsā-saṃ. ] (ti) CL=7 A starving person.
sujiṇṇa: [ su + jiṇṇa= jara + ta. Dhāna, ṭī. 254. Su + jiṅṇa-saṃ. ] (ti) CL=7 Extremely faded and decayed.
sujjhana: [ sudha + ya + yu. Sujcyati-mha. Nīti-dhātu. 231. ] (na) CL=7 Purification.
sujjhanti: [ sudha + ya + anti. Sujcyati-krañña့. ] (kri) CL=7 (1) They are purified. (2) They are graceful. See - Sujcyati (1) (3).
sujjhapetvā: [ sudha + ya + ṇāpe + tvā ] (kā, kri, vi) CL=7 Having caused to purify.
sujjhati: [ sudha + ya + ti. Nīti, dhātu. 231. Sujcyati, visujcyati imāni akamma-kāni. Nīti, dhātu. 381. ၐudhyati, ၐudhyate-saṃ. Sujcyai-prā, addhamāgadhī. ] (kri) CL=7 (1) He is purified. (2) He has abundant benefits. (3) He is graceful.
sujjhe: [ sudha + ya + eyya. Eyyassaekāro. ] (kri) CL=7 He should possess abundant benefits. See = Sujcyati (2)
sujjheyya: [ sudha + ya + eyya ] (kri) CL=7 See - Sujjye.
sujjheyyuṃ: [ sudha + ya + eyyuṃ ] (kri) CL=7 They should be pure.
sujjhissāmi: [ sudha + ya + ssāmi ] (kri) CL=7 He will be pure.
sujjhāpeti: [ sudha + ya + ṇape + ti. Sujcyati-၏kāriuka. ] (kā, kri) CL=7 Causes to purify. See below.
sujjhāpita: [ su + cyāpita= cyapa + ṇāpe + ta. Cyapa-dhāta= kၑpa-dhāta (pāṇinī. Dhātu. 1942) nhaṅa့ ññīrakāḥ dvebhokriukasodhātataññaḥ. ] (ti) CL=7 Has baked.
sujā: [ su + jana + kvi + ā. Tanaññaḥ-sujā + ṇa. Habyannādīnaṃ sukhaggahaṇatthaṃ jāyatīti sujā. Dhāna, ṭī. 418. Sī, ṭī, saca, 2. 267. Sujā tu homadabviyaṃ. Dhāna. 418. Homadabviyaṃ homakammani habyannā-dīnamuddharaṇatthaṃ katāyaṃ kaṭacchuyaṃ sujā. Dhāna, ṭī. 418. Dabvindajāyāsu sujā. Dhāna. 1112. Sujāsaddo dabviyaṃ kaṭacchuyaṃ, indajāyāyaṃ sakkassa bhariyāyañca. Dhāna,ṭī. 1112. Savati ghatādikaṃ assā (pattasmā) ti (sruca) sujā, yaññapatta-viseso. Kappudduma. ] (thī) CL=7 (1) The cup or a ladle for the sacrificial offering. (a ladle or cup that is used to take out and spray butter during the sacrificial offering).
sujākiriya: [ sujā + kiriya ] (thī, na) CL=7 Stirring with the sacrificial ladle.
sujāmukha: [ sujā + mukha ] (na) CL=7 Makes first and foremost for the sacrificial ladle.
sujāna: [ su + ñā + nā + a. Suḷa, suḷana-saṃ. Sujāṇa-prā. ] (ti) CL=7 Recognisible.
sujānanīya: [ su + ñā + nā + anīya ] (ti) CL=7 See - sujāna.
sujānanīyatthapariccheda: [ sujānanīya + attha + pariccheda ] (pu) CL=7 The boundary of the meaning of easily comprehending. See - Sujānanīya.
sujāpariyāya: [ sujā + pariyāya ] (pu) CL=7 The synonym or alternate term for the sacrificial ladle.
sujāsadda: [ sujā + sadda ] (pu) CL=7 The word - Sujā. See - Sujā (1).
sujāta: [ su + jana + ta. Kaccaññaḥ. 585. Nīti, sutta. 1189. Nirutti. 725. Su + jāti + a. Sujāta-saṃ. Sujāya-prā, addhamāgadhī. ] (ti) CL=7 (1) Good and beautiful body structure. (2) Well established. (3) The same family lineage. (4) Possessing good race or lineage.

[ su + jana + ta ] (pu) CL=7 (1) Lord Buddha named Sujāta. (2) A thera named Sujāta (A foremost disciple of Lord Buddha Padumuttara). (3) An ājīvaka (ascetic) named Sujāta (who offered the eight fistfuls of grass to Lord Buddha Piyadassī). (4) A king named Sujāta. (5) A bodhisatta named Sujāta. (6) A guardian of barley fields named Sujāta. (7) A universal monarch named Sujāta. (8) A brahmin named Sujāta. (9) A thera named Ven Sujāta (a Bārāṇasī townsfolk). (10) A rich man named Sujāta. (11) A person named Sujāta who is a bodhisatta of Lord Buddha Gotama (in Sujāta Jātaka). (12) A prince named Sujāta (the son of a king Assaka). (13) A young man (a wise man) named Sujāta.  (14) A Brahmin named Sujāta (a Bārāṇasī townsfolk).  (15) Sujātasutta.
sujātagatta: [ sujāta + gatta ] (ti) CL=7 Having a well-formed body or having a good body.
sujātagumba: [ sujāta + gumba ] (ti) CL=7 The place of the collection of smooth and polished posts or pillars.
sujātahaṃsasama: [ sujāta + haṃsa + sama ] (ti) CL=7 Resembling a great swan.
sujātajātaka: [ sujāta + jātaka ] (na) CL=7 Sujātajātaka teaches about a story of two people: a queen Sujāta is the future of Mallikādevī and a king Bārāṇasī is the future of King Kosala.
sujātakhattiyakumāra: [ sujāta + khattiyakumāra ] (pu) CL=7 A prince named Sujāta is in a pure and good family lineage.
sujātakumāra: [ sujāta + kumāra ] (pu) CL=7 A young man named Sujāta.
sujātarūpakāya: [ sujāta + rūpakāya ] (ti) CL=7 Possessing good and great appearance.
sujātasadda: [ sujāta + sadda ] (pu) CL=7 The word - sujāta.
sujātasujāta: [ sujāta + sujāta ] (ti) CL=7 Well-born and flourishing or Noble and prospering.
sujātatthera: [ sujāta + thera ] (pu) CL=7 A thera named Sujāta (the foremost disciple of Lord Buddha Padumuttara).
sujātattherī: [ sujātā + therī ] (thī) CL=7 A therī named Sujāta (the foremost female disciple) of Lord Buddha Padumuttara).
sujātatābhāva: [ sujātatā + abhāva ] (pu) CL=7 Absence of the honor of the family lineage.
sujātatādikulavaṇṇa: [ sujātatā + ādi + kula + vaṇṇa ] (pu, na) CL=7 The honor of the family, such as a person of good character.
sujātañcanatinīlakuṭilabhamuka: [ sujāta + añcana + atinīla + kuṭila + bhamuka ]  CL=9 Having dark blue and curve eyebrows because of the collyrium for the eyes that is made well- is dyed well.
sujāti: [ su + jāti. Sujāti-saṃ. Sujāi-prā. ] (ti) CL=7 (1) Possessing a good family lineage. (Thi) (2) Good family lineage.
sujātika: [ su + jāti + ka. Sujātīya-saṃ. ] (ti) CL=7 See - Sujāti (1).
sujātimantu: [ sujāti + mantu. Thī-၌ sujātimatī. ] (ti) CL=7 See - Sujāti (1).
sujātā: [ su + jana + ta + ā ] (thī) CL=7 (1) A therī named Sujāta (a foremost female disciple of Lord Buddha Sobhita). (2)  A therī named Sujātā (a foremost female disciple of Lord Buddha Piyadassī). (3) A woman named Sujātā (the mother of Lord Buddha Padumuttara).  (4) A woman named Sujātā (the mother of Lord Buddha Koṇḍañña). (5) A woman named Sujātā ( she will become the wife of a young man Magha in the future). (6) A daughter of a rich man named Sujātā (A female devotee who offers milk rice porridge to a buddha who enlightens in these days). (7) A devotee Sujātā (is a Sotāpana, is a Nātika villager). (8) A woman named Sujātā (the younger sister of a great woman Visākhā). (9) A woman named Sujātā  (in Maṇicorajātaka). (10) A therī named Sujātā (is the Sāketa townsfolk). (11) A queen named Sujātā.
sujātājīvaka: [ sujāta + ājīvaka ] (pu) CL=7 An ascetic (ājīvaka) named Sujāta (offered eight fistfuls of grass to Lord Buddha Piyadassī). See - Sujāta (3).
sujātātherī: [ sujātā + therī ] (thī) CL=7 A therī named Sujāta.
sujīva: [ su + jīva + a. Sujīva-saṃ. ] (na) CL=7 Capable of easily making a livelihood.
sujīvita: [ su + jīvita. Jīvita-krañña့. Sujīvita-saṃ. ] (na) CL=7 Good livelihood.
sujjheyyu: [ sudha + ya + eyyuṃ ] (kri) CL=7 They should be pure.
sujātahasasama: [ sujāta + haṃsa + sama ] (ti) CL=7 Resembling a great swan.
